# Data Source: yet_cloud_stacks

Every way a runtime can be — where, on what, and how traffic gets in: what a `yet_cloud_runtime`'s `stack` takes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "yet_cloud_stacks" "all" {}

# The stacks a runtime can be made on now.
output "available_stacks" {
  value = [for s in data.yet_cloud_stacks.all.stacks : s.id if s.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `stacks` (Attributes List) Each stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether it can be made now.
- `capabilities` (List of String) What a runtime of it can do.
- `description` (String) What it is for.
- `id` (String) What a runtime's `stack` takes: `local:traefik+k3s`.
- `ingress` (String) How traffic gets in: `traefik`, `alb`… — empty for none.
- `kind` (String) Where it runs: `local`, `aws`, `gcp`.
- `label` (String) Its name, as Cloud shows it.
- `runtime` (String) What runs things: `k3s`, `docker`, `native`, `ecs`…
